As this season's Premier League title race between Arsenal and Manchester City heats up, we take a look at the last time the title race went down to the last game of the season. During the 2021/22 season, both Manchester City and Liverpool were locked in a titanic clash, with one point the difference and one slip-up all it would take. The pressure was on Jurgen Klopp's and Pep Guardiola's teams. Relive each team's last 5 games in our new series "The Chase"
